## How it was checked

- [ ] `uv run pytest tests/ -q -n auto` passes.
- [ ] A new behavior has a test, and I confirmed the test fails without the change.

## Notes for the maintainer

- [ ] A user-visible change adds one file to `changelog.d/` ([format](https://github.com/rupe120/plan-tool/blob/main/changelog.d/README.md)), or this is docs-only, test-only or an internal refactor and I say so here.
- [ ] Docs that describe the changed behavior are updated.
- [ ] Nothing in the diff includes secrets, private paths or data from an employer or client.

Maintainers review and merge on an internal host and mirror `main` to GitHub, so
a maintainer carries an accepted pull request across and credits you. Read
[CONTRIBUTING](https://github.com/rupe120/plan-tool/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) for how changes are reviewed.
